name: Keells Fresh Nuwara Eliya Carrots
shortDesc: Crisp upcountry highland carrots freshly harvested and graded for sweet natural flavor.
description: Premium Grade-A fresh carrots grown in the nutrient-rich soils of Nuwara Eliya. Cleaned, graded, and packed daily with zero chemical wax coatings.

name: Fresh Bandakka (Okra / Lady's Fingers)
shortDesc: Tender young green okra pods harvested daily, perfect for traditional Sri Lankan curries.
description: Tender young lady's fingers picked early morning. Rich in natural dietary fiber and folates, perfect for tempered devilled dishes or coconut milk curries.

name: Sri Lankan Red Onions (Rathu Lunu)
shortDesc: Aromatic dry-zone local small red onions essential for authentic lunu miris and sambols.
description: Authentic Jaffna and dry-zone small red shallots. Intense aroma, natural sweetness, and firm skin ideal for daily tempered curries and fresh salads.

name: Fresh Green Chillies (Amu Miris)
shortDesc: Spicy, vibrant green chillies picked fresh from local farmers for Sri Lankan cooking.
description: Vibrant and punchy green chillies grown locally. Essential for everyday tempering, sambols, and fiery village dishes.

name: Fresh Organic Gotukola Leaves
shortDesc: Crisp Centella asiatica leaves harvested every sunrise for nutritious raw Sambol.
description: Clean, pesticide-free fresh Gotukola harvested at sunrise from freshwater beds. Best finely shredded with fresh grated coconut, red onions, and lime.

name: Sri Lankan Ambul Banana (Embul Kesel)
shortDesc: Classic tangy-sweet Sri Lankan sour bananas, rich in natural potassium and vitamins.
description: The nation's favorite banana variety. Small, aromatic, with a delightful balance of tangy sweetness and rich digestive fiber.

name: Fresh King Coconut (Thambili)
shortDesc: Native Sri Lankan golden king coconut filled with pure, refreshing electrolyte water.
description: Freshly cut golden King Coconut. Renowned worldwide for pure isotonic minerals, zero added sugars, and natural hydration in tropical climates.

name: Red Lady Sweet Papaya
shortDesc: Sun-ripened deep orange sweet papaya loaded with papain enzymes and Vitamin A.
description: Naturally tree-ripened Red Lady papaya. Velvety smooth texture, bursting with sweetness, and rich in natural digestive enzymes.

name: Kotmale Fresh Pasteurized Milk
shortDesc: Pure full cream dairy milk from highland cattle, pasteurized to international standards.
description: Wholesome 100% pure Sri Lankan cow's milk from Kotmale dairy farms. Rich in natural calcium, protein, and creamy goodness.

name: Highland Pure Salted Butter
shortDesc: The gold standard of Sri Lankan table butter, made from rich Ambewela fresh cream.
description: Creamy, golden, and lightly salted butter churned from pure Ambewela fresh dairy cream. Unmatched taste on fresh toast and village baking.

name: Traditional Buffalo Curd (Me Kiri)
shortDesc: Rich, thick, creamy natural buffalo curd set in traditional southern earthen clay pots.
description: Authentic southern Sri Lankan buffalo curd made with pure milk and live cultures. Thick creamy layer, perfectly enjoyed with natural Kithul treacle.

name: Farm Fresh Brown Eggs (Pack of 10)
shortDesc: Carefully inspected farm-fresh brown eggs with golden yolks, delivered daily.
description: Freshly laid brown eggs sourced from certified free-movement poultry farms. Rich in high-grade protein, choline, and omega fatty acids.

name: Keells Premium Keeri Samba Rice
shortDesc: Small pearl grain aromatic Keeri Samba, silky texture and favorite for yellow rice.
description: Premium aged Keeri Samba with short, oval white grains. Cooks light and fluffy without sticking, perfect for Sri Lankan fried rice and family curries.

name: CIC Supreme Red Basmati Rice
shortDesc: Long-grain red aromatic basmati rice celebrated for balanced nutrition and diabetes control.
description: Whole-grain red basmati combining the aroma of classic basmati with the nutrient density and antioxidants of traditional red bran.

name: Organic Suwandel Traditional Heritage Rice
shortDesc: Rare ancestral white fragrant rice famous for delicate aroma and digestive wellness.
description: Ancient non-hybrid Sri Lankan heritage rice cultivated without chemical weedicides. Renowned for centuries for its milky fragrance and low glycemic response.

name: Wijaya Roasted Curry Powder (Badapu Thuna Paha)
shortDesc: Authentic dark-roasted spice blend with coriander, cumin, fennel, and Ceylon cinnamon.
description: The quintessential Sri Lankan curry blend. Slowly wood-roasted to a deep aromatic mahogany, giving red meat and fish curries their iconic rich flavor.

name: Wijaya Pure Chilli Powder (Miris Kudu)
shortDesc: Pure sun-dried ground red chillies giving vibrant red color and authentic Lankan heat.
description: Cleaned, stem-removed, sun-dried red chillies ground under hygienic conditions. Zero artificial coloring or preservatives.

name: Pure Ceylon Alba Cinnamon Quills
shortDesc: World's finest True Ceylon Cinnamon quills with sweet aroma and ultra-low coumarin.
description: Genuine Cinnamomum verum Grade Alba. Multi-layered, wafer-thin quills rolled by hand. Naturally sweet, delicate, and cardioprotective.

name: Pure Sinharaja Kithul Treacle (Pani)
shortDesc: Wild palm sap syrup tapped in rainforest reserves. Perfect natural pair for curd.
description: 100% Pure Caryota urens blossom nectar tapped by generational artisans. No sugar cane additives. Low GI healthy sweetener.

name: Maggi Coconut Milk Powder
shortDesc: Real coconut milk powder for instant creamy first & second milk in Sri Lankan curries.
description: Spray-dried pure coconut milk made from fresh Sri Lankan coconuts. Dissolves instantly in warm water to produce rich kiri hodi.

name: Dilmah Premium Ceylon BOPF Tea
shortDesc: Finest single origin Ceylon broken orange pekoe fannings for a rich, golden brew.
description: Hand-picked Ceylon black tea from misty upcountry estates. Full-bodied, brisk, rich in natural polyphenols, and perfect with fresh milk.

name: Munchee Super Cream Cracker
shortDesc: Sri Lanka's iconic crispy, golden baked cream crackers loved with hot tea or cheese.
description: The country's undisputed favorite tea-time cracker. Crispy, light, perfectly baked, enriched with vitamins and minerals.

name: Maliban Lemon Puff Biscuits
shortDesc: Crispy sugar-dusted biscuits filled with real zesty lemon cream since 1954.
description: Crisp flaky golden puffs sandwiched with tangy real lemon cream. A timeless Sri Lankan treat enjoyed across generations.

name: Keells Bakery Fresh Roast Paan
shortDesc: Crusty, flat-baked village style roast bread, the ultimate pairing for spicy pol sambol.
description: Oven-baked to golden perfection with a signature crisp crust and soft center. Traditional Sri Lankan comfort food made fresh daily.
